front.title: Plain things,
front.note: Common Form is a small design studio. We make identities, books and posters for people who care how a thing is made, and we show our drawing as well as the result.

pages.title: Almond &
pages.summary: A neighbourhood bakery wanted to look the way it tastes: warm, plain and unhurried. We drew one mark and one wordmark, then tested every label against a loaf of bread.

pages.title: Field
pages.summary: A year of walks, set as a book that is pleasant to carry and slow to finish. One grid, one margin, and a green that is quiet without being grey.

pages.title: Low
pages.summary: A poster for an exhibition of the shore. The whole idea is one circle sitting on one line, and where the line goes.

pages.title: The studio
paras: Common Form is three people in one room. We work on a small number of projects at a time, and we would rather finish a few things than start many.
This page is a sample for a demonstration. The studio, its clients and its projects are made up.
principles: Begin with the room it will live in.
Draw it by hand before the screen.
Make fewer things, and finish them.
